command(New-Item -Path 'c:\Users\remak\source\repos\AsaSurvivor\scripts\components\health_component.gd' -ItemType File -Value 'extends Node
class_name HealthComponent

signal hp_changed(current_hp: int, max_hp: int)
signal died

@export var max_health: int = 100
var current_health: int
var is_invulnerable: bool = false
var invulnerability_duration: float = 0.5
var armor: int = 0

func _ready() -> void:
	current_health = max_health
	SignalBus.player_hp_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)

func set_max_health(value: int) -> void:
	max_health = value
	current_health = max_health
	SignalBus.player_hp_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)

func take_damage(amount: int, has_shield: bool = false) -> bool:
	if is_invulnerable or current_health <= 0:
		return false
		
	if has_shield:
		return true

	var actual_damage = max(1, amount - armor)
	current_health = max(0, current_health - actual_damage)
	
	hp_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)
	SignalBus.player_hp_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)

	if current_health <= 0:
		died.emit()
		SignalBus.player_died.emit()
	
	return false

func heal(amount: int) -> void:
	if current_health > 0 and current_health < max_health:
		current_health = min(current_health + amount, max_health)
		hp_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)
		SignalBus.player_hp_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)

func increase_max_health(amount: int, heal_amount: int) -> void:
	max_health += amount
	current_health = min(current_health + heal_amount, max_health)
	hp_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)
	SignalBus.player_hp_changed.emit(current_health, max_health)
')

command(New-Item -Path 'c:\Users\remak\source\repos\AsaSurvivor\scripts\components\experience_component.gd' -ItemType File -Value 'extends Node
class_name ExperienceComponent

signal level_up_pending
signal exp_changed(current_exp: int, max_exp: int, level: int)

var level: int = 1
var current_exp: int = 0
var exp_to_next_level: int = 30
var pending_level_ups: int = 0

func _ready() -> void:
	SignalBus.player_exp_changed.emit(current_exp, exp_to_next_level, level)

func add_exp(amount: int) -> void:
	current_exp += amount
	SignalBus.score_gained.emit(amount)
	
	var leveled_up := false
	while current_exp >= exp_to_next_level:
		current_exp -= exp_to_next_level
		level += 1
		exp_to_next_level = int(exp_to_next_level * 1.5)
		pending_level_ups += 1
		leveled_up = true
	
	exp_changed.emit(current_exp, exp_to_next_level, level)
	SignalBus.player_exp_changed.emit(current_exp, exp_to_next_level, level)
	
	if leveled_up and pending_level_ups > 0:
		level_up_pending.emit()
		SignalBus.player_level_up_pending.emit()

func consume_pending_level_up() -> void:
	pending_level_ups = max(0, pending_level_ups - 1)
	if pending_level_ups > 0:
		level_up_pending.emit()
		SignalBus.player_level_up_pending.emit()
')
